name: Harper Agent

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: You know Thieves’ Cant. Choose one Musical Instrument proficiency. When Help assists an ally’s attack, you may distract an enemy 30 feet away if it can see or hear you.

benefits.name: Distracting Melody
benefits.summary: When Help assists an ally’s attack, you may distract an enemy 30 feet away if it can see or hear you.
benefits.text: Your Help action can distract an enemy up to 30 feet away instead of 5, as long as it can see or hear you.
